features: 【⌨️ 104-Key Full-Size Keyboard】Designed for comfortable everyday typing with a full-size 104-key layout, including a dedicated numeric keypad and Indian Rupee (₹) key. The soft membrane keys provide a quiet, responsive typing experience, making it ideal for office work, education and home use.

【🎵 12 Multimedia Shortcut Keys】Boost productivity with 12 dedicated multimedia function keys for quick access to volume control, media playback, email and frequently used functions. Save time and simplify everyday tasks with convenient one-touch shortcuts.

【🖱️ Silent Optical Mouse】The included wireless mouse features advanced optical tracking for smooth and accurate cursor control on most surfaces without requiring a mouse pad. Silent click buttons reduce noise, making it perfect for offices, libraries, classrooms and shared workspaces.

【📡 Reliable 2.4GHz Wireless Connection】Experience stable and lag-free performance with 2.4GHz wireless technology and a compact USB Nano Receiver. Enjoy clutter-free connectivity with an operating range of up to 10 meters, allowing flexible and comfortable workspace setup.

【💻 Plug & Play with Wide Compatibility】Simply plug in the USB receiver and start working instantly, no drivers or software required. Compatible with Windows, macOS, Linux and ChromeOS, this combo also features Auto Power Save Mode to help maximize battery life during extended use.
